description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). Free start times for the service (with these answers and units — they set how long the work takes) over the next days, from tomorrow. Each time has a slot_id for book_appointment. Times are the company's local time.

answers.description: Answers to the service's questions: { question_id: option_id | [option_ids] | number | text }. Use the ids from list_services.

company.description: The company: the `company` of a find_companies result.

days.description: How many days ahead to look. Default 7.

units.description: How many (air conditioners, sockets, taps… — as the service asks) — only for services that count them. Default 1.

name: check_availability
title: Free times
